what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in Denmark, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4475 Eritrean refugees in Denmark, 0.8% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia and Sudan host the most Eritrean refugees, followed by Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records interstate armed conflicts between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000 and in 2016, and between Djibouti and Eritrea in 2008.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea in 1997, 1999 and 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1999 at 25 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 6033, at the end of 2023.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Denmark.
These are year-end totals for Denmark only, reported to UNHCR.
